checks: Recomputed the baseline changed cell probability (1+kappa)/16 using independent W,Z fair assignment, complier mass kappa, noisy always-takers and fair outcomes.
The two changed cells differ by plus/minus kappa*t/4, so chi-square divergence is exactly 2 kappa^2 t^2/(1+kappa); iid KL is bounded by 2n kappa^2 t^2.

Checked monotonicity/exclusion and target t in the latent construction. The small fixed c choice t=c min(1,1/(sqrt(n) kappa)) stays within [0,1/4] and keeps total variation bounded below one, giving the scoped squared-error lower order.
